verdict.rationale: Apple publishes some concrete specs. Memory support is stated as up to 64GB unified memory at 273GB/s, and there are Thunderbolt 5 and display figures. However, much of the material is marketing language ('blazing speed', 'stunning imagery') and relative claims like '2.1x faster' with no stated test conditions. Missing for 10: CPU/GPU clock speeds, power/TDP figures, Neural Engine AI TOPS, test conditions behind performance claims, independent corroboration of the spec sheet.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can comparison-shop from a real spec sheet — the vendor publishes clocks, power, memory support, and AI TOPS with test conditions, instead of marketing adjectives

citations.quote: M4 Pro supports up to 64GB of fast unified memory and 273GB/s of memory bandwidth
M4 Pro also supports Thunderbolt 5 on Mac, delivering up to 120Gb/s data transfer speeds
Up to two external displays with up to 6K resolution at 60Hz over Thunderbolt
